You can walk from what was before when the sea filled the center of the USA, through the entirety of the eras of when it was filled with water and then to the other side from when the sea retreated again. All in a few steps. It's really cool and nobody would know, but once you see it, it cannot be unseen. The dirt that is in this space doesn't even look like it belongs in Colorado.
